deep_analysis:
1 open trade: LTC LONG bb-bounce-v2-long+ (meta_rsi 50.77, entry 59.745). Live price recovered to ~59.84 (+0.16%); watchdog snapshot caught it at -0.39% mid-dip. LTC 15m regime NEUTRAL/ranging — this is a chop entry on a net-negative signal family (bb-bounce-v2-long+: 27T, 44.4% WR, -0.63 USDT lifetime). Thesis is weak but the trade is salvageable: hold while above 59.50, exit manually if it stalls below entry for another hour rather than waiting for SL 59.13 — chop trades rarely earn trail arm (52/56 hard_max_loss history).

Last 20 closes: 7W/13L, net -0.43 USDT. The losses cluster into three wrong-side patterns:
(1) Mid-RSI LONGs into dead BTC — DOGE/ARB/LDO ai-trader+ and ME/ETC bb-bounce longs all entered at meta_rsi 46-53 while BTC velocity was SLOW. Right RSI band, wrong market condition: no trend to carry them, stops hit on noise. The winning side was cash, or the short that faded the stall.
(2) Shorting oversold — HYPE SHORT volume-buildup- entered at meta_rsi 38.1 and lost -1.32%; HYPE then pumped to LONG_BIAS conf 91.7. BANANA lesson repeating: the winning side was the LONG, we shorted an oversold dip inside an uptrend.
(3) Right side, wrong timing — ARB LONG pump-chain+ (-1.67%) and ai-trader+ (-4.64%) were both longs, and ARB then ripped +1.97% (15m LONG_BIAS conf 79.9). We were on the correct side but entered during consolidation with stops too tight for ARB's ~1.8% ATR; the winner was the same long held or entered after the shakeout.

ai-trader+ family confirmed bleed: 29T, 41.4% WR, -0.80 USDT, 3-loss streak — all LONGs at RSI 46-51 under SLOW velocity. Not a disable case (brain auditor's call), but do not stack more mid-RSI longs while BTC velocity stays SLOW.

Only 1/6 slots deployed — no cluster or correlation risk. BTC 1h ATR is 0.033% (range 82010-82101): dead quiet. The live opportunity is alt-momentum (WLD/HYPE/SYRUP/ARB LONG_BIAS), not BTC itself.
regime_context: BTC 82090, AT EMA300 (82017) after reclaiming it ~22:00 UTC. 15m and 4h both LONG_BIAS, linreg LEAN_BULL, trend_quality UP — directionally mild-long. But velocity SLOW, volume LOW, 1h ATR 0.033%, continuum state 'AT': this is a low-vol grind at the trend boundary, not a confirmed trend. 4 regime flips/24h = chop risk elevated. Longs are the aligned side (don't short BTC here), but expect noise: size down, demand ATR>0.5% on alt entries, and avoid mid-band RSI chases on dead-vol names. Alts with independent momentum (WLD 88.6, HYPE 91.7, SYRUP 93.6, ARB 79.9 LONG_BIAS) are where the pumps are.

1) ai-trader+ LONG bleed under SLOW velocity — n=29, WR 41.4%, total -0.80 USDT. Current 3-loss streak: DOGE -2.04% (rsi 46.2), ARB -4.64% (rsi 51.4), LDO -2.22% (rsi 53.6). All mid-band RSI longs. WINNING SIDE: short the stall or stay flat — these coins went nowhere for the trade's lifetime. Root cause: mid-RSI longs need BTC velocity; velocity is SLOW.

2) bb-bounce-v2-long+ negative expectancy — n=27, WR 44.4%, total -0.63 USDT. Losers ME -3.54%, ETC -4.12% rode to full SL; winners LTC +1.20%, ME +1.16%, ETC +2.12% took small TPs. WINNING SIDE: same signal but the winners hit TP first — this is an exit-asymmetry problem on a chop-entry signal. Current open LTC is on this family.

3) Oversold SHORT against uptrend — HYPE volume-buildup- SHORT at meta_rsi 38.1 lost -1.32%; HYPE now LONG_BIAS conf 91.7, +0.67%/4h. GOAT pump-chain- SHORT at rsi 73.6 lost -0.97%. WINNING SIDE: the LONG. Shorting an oversold dip inside a LONG_BIAS coin is the BANANA pattern repeating — do not take SHORTs on coins with 15m LONG_BIAS conf > 85.

4) Stop-too-tight on high-ATR alts — ARB two long losses (-1.67%, -4.64%) then +1.97% pump. ARB 1h ATR 0.79-1.85%. WINNING SIDE: the long, held through the shakeout. Lesson: on ATR>1% coins, SL must clear at least 1.5x recent swing or the trade is a coin flip against noise.
